achievements.name: New Look
achievements.detail: Choose the Mechanic's appearance before heading out.

achievements.name: First Raid
achievements.detail: Pick an island, splat the Salmonids in the way, and bring salvage back.

achievements.name: Spirhalite
achievements.detail: Scoop up Spirhalite Crystals while exploring a raid.

achievements.name: Crystal Drill
achievements.detail: Drill open a crystal cache and take the treasure it was holding.

achievements.name: Ink Swim
achievements.detail: Change to Swim Form and travel through a path of your own ink.

achievements.name: Bot Buddy
achievements.detail: Call a Deep Cut Bot Buddy into battle and jump from it to cross a gap.

achievements.name: Showstopper
achievements.detail: Gather six Power Eggs and fire a Showstopper.

achievements.name: Hideout Craft
achievements.detail: Spend salvage on the Hideout Ship to craft an enhancement.

achievements.name: Tank Gadget
achievements.detail: Take a Speed, Power, or Tactical tank on a mission and use one of its gadgets.

achievements.name: Salmonid Den
achievements.detail: Collect a Salmonid Den's Power Eggs before the timer runs out.

achievements.name: Buried Ruins
achievements.detail: Clear the stacked underground floors of a Buried Ruins raid.

achievements.name: Sampler Dungeon
achievements.detail: Reach the end of a Sampler Dungeon built around one weapon or gadget.

achievements.name: Co-op Raid
achievements.detail: Clear a stage with other players online or over local wireless.

achievements.name: Survivalist
achievements.detail: Finish a raid with the combat difficulty set to Survivalist.
